symbols.name: AsyncKeyedLock.ILease
symbols.summary: Reserves one acquisition attempt for a key and releases any acquired lock when disposed.
symbols.remarks: Dispose can be called repeatedly. During a pending wait, disposal defers cleanup until the wait settles. Use the acquisition's cancellation token to interrupt the wait. Keep the lease alive while using an acquired lock.

symbols.name: TryAcquireAsync(TimeSpan, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Attempts to acquire the reserved key once.

syntax.content: Task TryAcquireAsync(TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

parameters.description: The wait limit. Use zero for an immediate attempt or System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan to wait indefinitely.
The token used to cancel the wait.

returns.description: True on acquisition or false on timeout. A timeout, cancellation, or failed wait returns the reservation to the pool.
